requirements.rule: MULTI-WEEK SCHEDULE: the premiums of the orario plurisettimanale of Art. 5 as renewed on 22 November 2025 are the bands OT_PLURI (15%), OT_PLURI_SABATO (25%) and, for sudden needs, OT_PLURI_IMPROVVISO (20%) and OT_PLURI_IMPROVVISO_SABATO (30%), premium only. Not modelled: their rise 'a partire dalla 81esima ora' ('elevate nella misura onnicomprensiva dell'8%'), which needs the hours of the schedule worked in the year. The night-holiday work of Art. 7 rows h) and i) is paid by the FED_NOTTURNO_FESTIVO* supplement bands, the shift column of the overtime by OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI, OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI_EXTRA and OT_NOTTURNO_FESTIVO_TURNI for an event with in_periodic_shift.
requirements.remediation: Add the hours of the multi-week schedule worked in the year to pay the 8% from the 81st hour, then resolve this limitation.
